bullets.text: BritCard Faces Trust Issues - **BritCard**'s success hinges on overcoming public skepticism about government control of digital identities.
Digital Migration Could Save Billions - Transitioning to digital services could yield over £3 billion in benefits for the UK by 2040.
Connected Britain Awards Celebrate Innovation - The **Connected Britain Awards 2025** highlight outstanding contributions to the UK's digital economy.
AI Agent Rollout by SK Telecom - **SK Telecom** plans to deploy its AI agent across 25 companies, enhancing operational efficiency.
Optus Fined for Customer Exploitation - **Optus** faces a AU$100 million fine for predatory sales practices targeting vulnerable customers.
Huawei Cloud Expands AI Capabilities - **Huawei Cloud** announces plans to enhance AI infrastructure, doubling output of Ascend AI chips.
MS3 Partners with Zen Internet - **Zen Internet** collaborates with **MS3 Networks** to enhance fibre connectivity in Northern England.
Russia Stalking NATO Satellites - Concerns grow over **Russia**'s surveillance of commercial satellites used by NATO members.
Deloitte Launches AI Infrastructure Center - **Deloitte** opens a global AI Infrastructure Center of Excellence to support AI data center operations.
